name: Jii 2 ~Kohitsuji-tachi no Nemurenai Yoru~
original_name: 自慰2～仔羊達の眠れない夜～
source:
A catholic female college in the Meiji Era. Old priest gets hurt and hero is invited as a temporary priest substitute. Main character decides to defile this garden of innocent angels.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
明治时代的一所天主教女子大学。老牧师受伤后，主人公受邀暂代牧师。主人公决定玷污这座纯真天使的花园。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
